evidence.quoted_text:
require(external.get("external_completion_delta") == 0,
            "external activation produced a completion before release")
evidence.reason: The pinned assertion only validates the delta between the two during-callback completion samples. A queued completion that lands after the pre-switch completion log is read but before the first callback sample is present in both samples, so the delta is zero and the fence test can false-pass. Comparing the first pause sample against the pre-switch log is an ordinary test-correctness fix, not a new requirement.
